newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Rashid Hussain to detail Kwong Yik deal.
newsitem.headline: Rashid Hussain to detail Kwong Yik deal.

text.p: Malaysian stockbroker Rashid Hussain Bhd said it will detail a deal to buy Kwong Yik Bank Bhd as well as a restructuring plan at a news conference on Tuesday.

In a statement sent out late on Monday, the country's largest institutional stockbroker said it will discuss a "proposed restructuring" involving itself, its 20-percent owned associate DCB Holdings Bhd's banking unit and Kwong Yik. The conference is set at 1.45 p.m. (0545 GMT).
Rashid said this would lead "to the creation of Malaysia's largest fully integrated financial services group".
Rashid Hussain has been in talks for at least a month with the nation's largest bank Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) to buy Maybank's 75 percent stake in Kwong Yik.
Analysts estimate the price for the stake to be more than two billion ringgit.
Maybank is also holding a news conference to discuss the Kwong Yik deal on Tuesday at 5 p.m. (0900 GMT).

In the statement, the company said its executive chairman Rashid Hussain will give the opening remarks, and that the firm's head of corporate finance Chatchai Pusavat will detail the restructuring plan.
Yvonne Chia, chief executive officer of DCB Holdings, will assess the benefits from the merger, the statement said.
The stocks of Rashid, DCB, Kwong Yik and Maybank have all been suspended since October 21 for the deal announcement.
